text: Tera Holding's main owner and largest shareholder is its co-founder and chairman Emre Tezmen; his father, former transport minister Oğuz Tezmen, is also a major shareholder with 25.17% of the group.
short: Tera Holding's main owner is Emre Tezmen

source.name: Memur Haber 365: Eski Bakan Oğuz Tezmen'in Hissedar Olduğu Dev Şirkette Operasyon Şoku!
source.quote: Tera Holding'in ana sahibi ve en büyük paydaşı, şirketin kurucu ortağı ve Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı olan iş insanı Emre Tezmen'dir.
source.note: Article cites SPK and KAP records for management and voting control in Tera Group flagship companies, and gives Oğuz Tezmen's stake as 25.17%. Milli Gazete (15 September 2026) reports the same management structure but cautions that published management roles alone do not prove the full share distribution.
